主要内容: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (NYSE: HST) announced the acquisition of the 643-room Phoenician, a Luxury Collection resort, for $400 million. The hotel is located in Scottsdale, Arizona, with 83,500 square feet of meeting space and a 27-hole golf course. The purchase includes two adjacent parcels of land for potential residential development. The Company plans a renovation during the low-occupancy summer period. Starwood will continue to operate the hotel under The Luxury Collection® brand. The Company also sold the Sheraton Needham for $54 million and the Crowne Plaza Amsterdam for €106.2 million. It expects to sell two additional assets for a combined $90 million. The Company repurchased 5.55 million shares for $111.7 million. It also renamed the Four Seasons Philadelphia to 'The Logan' and The Ritz-Carlton Phoenix to 'The Camby'. The Company shifted management of another hotel to an independent third party.
